'''Surveillance''' was a branch of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence's]] [[Bureau of Operations/Legends|Bureau of Operations]]. Unlike their [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] [[Surveillance (Imperial Security Bureau)/Legends|counterpart]], Surveillance was a relatively small operation, with one agent for every seventy employed by COMPNOR. Despite the fewer personnel assigned to the organization, it kept watch on more serious threats than its rival. Surveillance agents sorted through mountains of material on [[megascandoc]]s and were trained to make sense of the information to discover suspects bent on anti-Imperial activity. Surveillance agents were thoroughly briefed on their mission, and assistance from local [[system cell]]s was often called on.<ref name="ISB" />

Surveillance agents were well trained in combat skills and other appropriate talents, and were expected to perform solo in the field without reinforcement. They were expected to make arrests where possible, but to ensure that a target never escaped if arrest was unlikely.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
